summary.text: Aaron Rouse is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia for District 22, serving since 2023. The Senate's member page lists committee assignments including Privileges and Elections (chair), Commerce and Labor, and Finance and Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: Rouse was born in Norfolk, Virginia, on January 8, 1984, and attended Virginia Tech, according to the Senate's member page.

The page describes District 22 as parts of the city of Virginia Beach and lists him as chair of the Privileges and Elections Committee, with seats on Commerce and Labor, Finance and Appropriations, General Laws and Technology, and Rules.
